articles.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
articles.description: Ukraine's leader says he will support such a truce if Moscow does, after initially expressing surprise at Donald Trump's announcement.

articles.title: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
